615o:
In this program, students learn how decisions they make contribute directly to the organisation’s success. Students will be empowered with knowledge of how to become a leader in business and understand the pillars of a sustainable business model. Lecturers’ strong network connections and the Work Integrated Learning program ensures students receive relevant industry placements.

In the first year, students will study core subjects relevant to all business majors. Students can then tailor the degree to suit their interests by selecting a preferred major and possible minor.

In the Business Intelligence and Information Systems major, students earn how to integrate information technology systems and data into business strategies and work with digital information systems to manage large amounts of data securely. Students use their insight as a business intelligence analyst to create cost-effective systems for business enterprises and identify business opportunities. Students ensure their employability and maximise their opportunities in this rapidly growing industry. Graduates can apply for membership with the Australian Institute of Management (AIM).

With the aim of equipping students with real-world experience, students will start preparing for Work Integrated Learning in their first year of study. Embedded throughout the degree, employability and career development tools prepare students for a final-year capstone subject where students have the flexibility to complete an internship within a local business or multidisciplinary project for an industry partner. Students who work full-time have the option to complete an independent project for their employer.

Additionally, students in Townsville will have the opportunity to in the Townsville Chamber of Commerce — James Cook University Mentoring Program. Students will build and strengthen your network and gain the skills and confidence necessary to excel.

Managing finances, resources, and direct business operations with confidence in a fast-paced setting. 5p57:
In the Bachelor of Commerce, students gain an understanding of foundational concepts of commerce and pursue their passion in one or two key commerce areas. Students learn the importance of data-driven decision making and graduate with skills relevant to a large number of industries.

Students develop essential job-readiness skills through the work-integrated learning capstone program and network with leading commerce professionals. Students can broaden their horizons and gain a global perspective by completing one semester at JCU Singapore, or at one of JCU's 52 partnering universities around the world.

As a commerce graduate, students acquire skills are relevant to a large number of businesses and industries. Their major specialisation will provide pathways and job opportunities for career success. Students will have the ability to understand the importance of data-driven decision making – a quality highly valued by employers.
5p58:
JCU Brisbane’s Bachelor of Information Technology brings together the knowledge and technical skills that are essential when students are ready to make a start in their professional IT career. Students will learn about Cyber-Security, Networking, Interactive Visualisation, Big Data and Data Mining, Data Science, Web Technologies, Mobile Technologies, Programming, Design Thinking and a lot more.

Students will also have the opportunity to apply their skills to real-life business projects through an industry placement or project – this allows them the ability to built their CV while they study. The projects students work on will give them genuine workplace skills and give them the opportunity to be contributing to the industry too.

Graduates are eligible to become an Associate Member of the Australian Computer Society (ACS).

Through a partnership with the Student Association, IT Students at James Cook University Brisbane Campus have access to free ACS membership, earning many benefits such as:

  • Complimentary attendance at ACS Queensland seminars and webinars, opening up ACS employer networks;
  • Complimentary access to the ACS Careers Platform, including member-only job search to uncover internship and job opportunities;
  • Free casual use access to the River City Labs start-up precinct at Fortitude Valley;
  • Ability to develop their skills further with soft-skill and technical short courses and technical practice exams on the free ACS Learning Accelerator.
5p59:
This program incorporates pertinent knowledge from a variety of the disciplines which underpin studies of tourism, hospitality and events systems. The introductory business units provide a meaningful foundation to the study of the concepts and principles relating to sustainability, cultures and people.

These themes permeate the food and beverage management, project management, tourism and leisure management, conference and event management aspects of the course which form the basis of operational activities involving the cross – cultural management of people.

This foundation is supplemented by studies relating to innovation in hospitality operations management, revenue and yield management, visitor and crowd behaviour management and destination management and planning. Success in these areas is essential to survive and prosper in the competitive business environments embraced by this degree.
5p5h:
There is a growing demand for graduates skilled in a range of IT technologies – multimedia, computing, networking and software technologies. In addition, there is worldwide demand for graduates with the critical business skills and acumen to fully leverage these technical skills into profitable products and services.

This joint degree at JCU provides training in a variety of computer support skills, and includes preparation for industry standard certification in Microsoft technologies. This program emphasises advanced people and project management skills, together with ethical behaviour and professional vigour.
5p5j:
The Master of International Tourism and Hospitality Management – Master of Business Administration is an innovative joint postgraduate level qualification that combines tourism, hospitality and business management to give students the management skills required to be a professional in the tourism and hospitality industry.

It provides graduates from a range of disciplines with the skills needed to sustainably manage tourism products, resources, and infrastructure.

Coursework subjects are diverse and include areas such as tourism analysis and strategy, tourism systems analysis, hospitality and gastronomy, global destination competitiveness, economic decision making in hospitality, tourist behaviour, sustainability and marketing.
5p5k:
The Master of Professional Accounting – Master of Business Administration (MPA-MBA) program is designed for students who intend to work as professional

accountants and in senior management positions.

A joint master’s degree allows graduates to stand out to future employers. The course delivers comprehensive training in accounting and finance whilst exposing students to key management areas including; human relations, marketing, business law, taxation, economics and business information systems.
8h8x:
JCU students have the advantage of learning how to apply data science skills to tropical, regional, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander contexts. Benefit from industry expertise with courses taught by data scientists, SAS partnership and certification, and access to the SAS data Science Academy.

Learn to exercise the professional judgment to suit specific circumstances and have the opportunity to complete a substantial research-based project. Stduent's capstone project will allow them to build a portfolio to showcase their expertise.

Upon graduating, they will be across recent developments and modern challenges in data science and equipped with skills in key areas including machine learning, data mining, algorithm development, and advanced modelling.
64ld:
JCU’s Master of Engineering Management is ideal for professional engineers and other technical professionals seeking a higher qualification that will develop their project management and business management skills. Over the course of this two-year degree, students will complete subjects on project management, engineering management, sustainable economics, and strategic resource and operations management. Students will also participate in work-integrated learning through an industry placement, preparing them with skills for your career.

Developing and managing sustainable projects is critical to the successful completion and continued operation of engineering ventures. The learnings embedded in this course incorporate authentic and practical knowledge that will support students to develop a broad range of management skills that are in demand across engineering and related industries.

Students will transfer their knowledge and skills to the workplace and network with prospective employers and peers. The networking available within their placements could lead to further opportunities post-graduation. In addition to employment opportunities, having increased industry connections can valuably contribute to students' role in project management.

The Master of Engineering Management is designed in consultation with industry experts to ensure familiarity with professional practice both in Australia and overseas. Students will be equipped to manage projects at new scales and levels of complexity, while satisfying the Project Management Institute’s (PMI) professional standards. This degree is also aligned with a number of Australian and international standards, including the United Nations Principles for Responsible Management Education, the Associate to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business, and the Australian Qualifications Framework.

As managers of projects, technology, infrastructure and people, Engineering Managers need to be aware of and ready to actively oversee complex projects for social, environmental and cultural sustainability. This Engineering Management degree will equip students with the skills to meet such a standard as well as the practical experience required to deliver successful projects on time, on budget and in line with community and professional expectations.

The Master of Engineering Management’s combination of technical and practical knowledge will enable students to apply management tools and management methods to complex projects as well as develop confidence for leadership in both interpersonal and technical settings
5p5g:
The Master of Information Technology, majoring in Computing & Networking advances both skills and knowledge in design, management and maintenance of computer networks, and develops technical skills using advanced technologies.

The program emphasises work-integrated learning and develops employability skills through practical projects and the option of an internship increasing graduate employability.

Students can complete the Master of Information Technology as an independent award or combine it with the Master of Business Administration (MBA) as a joint degree.
5p5e:
Students gain real-world experience in the tourism and hospitality industry. Students will develop the skills to become a management-level professional with expert knowledge of business operations, administration and handling international clients. Students can acquire strong career planning insights and build critical enterprise skills through the Professional Employability Program.

Students learn from expert lecturers who are leaders in their fields. With a focus on sustainability, innovation and effective leadership, you will learn how to make decisions using critical thinking and analyse high-level issues.

Students can also enhance their employability and advance their career in Australia and globally through the Masters Employability Program. In this program, students complete a structured co-curricular employability skills and development program, which runs for the duration of the degree. This includes a tailored plan to support individual employment objectives, beginning from semester one through to graduation.
5p5d:
By choosing to study an MPA at JCU Brisbane, students will undertake advanced learning in both theory and professional practice whilst learning to solve accounting and business problems in innovative ways. Students will be equipped with the skills to advise companies on current and future financial issues, enabling strategic goals to be achieved.

Students completing the MPA degree are in an excellent position to succeed in managerial positions in a range of government and commercial organisations. MPA graduates from JCU are well-placed to enter organisations in industries such as mining, manufacturing, retail, consulting, human resources and marketing.

Students undertake subjects spanning the full spectrum of business skills including accounting, economics, business law, taxation, statistics, human relations, finance, marketing leadership and strategy, to ensure they have all the skills and knowledge necessary to fulfil the complex role of an accountant.

The Master of Professional Accounting is open to graduates from any discipline and can also be taken as a joint degree with the Master of Business Administration (MBA).
5p5c:
JCU’s Master of Business Administration [2-Year] degree has a strong focus on applying and integrating sustainable economic, social and environmental business performance thinking and methods to new or existing business models. Students will learn how to evaluate the context of a business or organisation and identify the appropriate performance method/s that will enhance its performance or solve a key issue within the business’s framework. Students will study a broad body of theoretical and technical knowledge and gain skills in critically analysing complex contemporary business issues and making effective decisions or recommendations for improvement.

This two-year, leadership-oriented Master of Business Administration degree has ten core subjects covering a broad range of topics and will equip you to work effectively in any field of business. Students can specialise their degree by choosing from five majors, including Conflict Management and Resolution, Leadership, Entrepreneurship, Finance and Project Management.

Students can also choose to undertake either a research project, or a professional internship with one of JCU’s leading industry partners. Both the research project and the internship provide extensive experience that will prepare them for their future career as well as domestic and international networking opportunities that will benefit their professional development.
5p5l:
The Master of Education – Master of Business Administration (MEd/MBA) program is for career enhancement and to develop strong educational management capabilities. Students entering with a Business, Management or Education/training background will be able to enhance their knowledge and skills to perform leadership roles relevant to education.

Students in this program will learn contemporary approaches to leadership within education and managerial environments. A global approach will enhance students’ capacity to function effectively in diverse professional situations. Students will have important opportunities to engage in research action activities as well as a capstone major project. There is also an opportunity for participation in an internship with a professional organisation.
